title: Middle East war live: Trump threatens massive US strikes if Iran blocks oil flow in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards on Tuesday said they would not allow “one litre of oil” to leave the Middle East if US and Israeli attacks continue. President Donald ​Trump has warned that ​the US would hit Iran much harder if Tehran stopped the ​flow ‌of oil through ⁠the Strait of Hormuz. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
